The instant filtering feels quick and natural, and the query behaviour matches what I expect. Plain words are case-insensitive, quotes keep a phrase together, and `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, and parentheses give me useful control without making ordinary searches harder. The no-results message and immediate reset when I clear the search are right too.

I’m happy with this search behaviour, with the understanding that `#tagname` must search actual tags and bookmark notes must be included once those features exist.
